criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 9, 1, 3 and 4 strong (counts checked in pixels); 8 a mid-tone quote card, 7's board a Gantt-like panel and a robot-arm rig, 2 a card-grey plan with dark-stub cameras, 6 an empty weave band; light direction flips on 9.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One cold dark interior, the container and camera motifs working, the 3 to 4 hold the best cut; gold leaks onto 2 and 7, 8 is the one bright frame, reliefs alternate with renders.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the drawn counts match; all sources primary and the blog attributed; 5's headline states a 95% interval as bounds, the dek fixes it.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where clear; 9 gives a patient something concrete; no next step or place to act.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 3 to 6 builds then qualifies, 7 is a real turn and 8 follows; 9 lands as a coda.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and careful, a science-desk register with key-to-the-chart lines.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A new world; the one-unit-per-count move, a fourth medical deck in 16 days, a second journal study in four days.

contested: Frame 8 as type on a plate

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mid-tone beige quote card, flattest bands in the deck.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut the page to about 60 percent of its area, curl it so it casts, one narrow raking pool falling off hard below the c13 line.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A Gantt-like board, a robot-arm rig, a gold block, a dead band above the tile.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Recolour the gold block, one wall plate, lens axis on the board's lanes, modelled magnets and tray, tile raised to the dek.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A card-grey floor plan, dark-stub cameras with gold rings.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A 30 degree oblique aerial, cameras 1.5 times larger with cold white rings.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An empty weave band between the dek and the clamps.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Move the rank up about 250 px, rings off the bottom edge, a lower key for longer casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An evenly lit wall reading as a flat block with a tan band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A real pool from high left with the right third and corners falling to black; the same on 3.

_note: Transcribed from the judge's hand-back by the showrunner; scores, total and weakest frames as returned, reasons abridged.
